name: University Canada West
description:
Do you want to study at a university dedicated to student well-being?

Approximately 1500 international students study at University Canada West, an institution with proven employability and a 5-star QS rating from the official ranking system. 

94% of MBA students are working or have a job lined up within one year of graduation from UCW.

University Canada West has a lot to offer students, including a popular downtown Vancouver campus location, numerous scholarships for international students and the chance to become a successful business leader with its accredited MBA programs.

There are many reasons to study at University Canada West

  • Knowledgeable teachers with industry experience and a practical approach to teaching
  • Over 110 countries represented in the multicultural student body, on a diverse campus
  • UCW is the 3rd University in Canada to have secured a QS 5 Star rating out of 7 North American universities.

Are you unsure how to turn your aspirations of studying in Canada into reality? Perhaps you need to know a little more about how the university could benefit you before applying? Or maybe you just want to know more about different aspects of student life, including accommodation, employability and the availability of scholarships?

Discover why University Canada West might just be the place for you!

View courses now

About the University

University Canada West is a private University in British Columbia, Canada. It was established in 2005 by David F. Strong, the former president of the University of Victoria.

Over 110 countries are represented in the diverse student body, with around 1500 international students enrolled in courses annually. More than 412 full-time and sessional faculty members work at the University, with more than half of this number supporting student well-being.

About the University

University Canada West has a well-stocked library with many books, journals, and online resources to support students' learning and research needs. The student lounge is a space where students can relax and socialise with other students. It is fully equipped with comfortable seating, Wi-Fi, and kitchen facilities. Numerous study spaces are available on campus, including individual study rooms, group study rooms, and open study spaces. Students entirely use a fitness center, counselling services and career services. The University is also committed to allowing students with disabilities equal access to educational opportunities.

Why University Canada West?

  • Graduates often go on to work with top companies such as Google, Amazon, Deloitte and others thanks to its high placement rate and strong emphasis on employability.
  • Career-focused teaching style with globally recognised business programs.
  • Based in Vancouver, an area with a high cost of living and a reputation for being safe and inclusive.

Join the ranks of future-focused graduates from an accredited university and get ahead in your chosen career thanks to a highly-ranked teaching faculty. 

You have the power to shape your reality. Start by turning your aspirations into action.

Launch your future alongside a global network of successful UCW alumni.

Browse courses easily today!

Student Life

Student life is varied due to the number of international students coming together on campus and the surplus of movie nights, holiday parties, and social events organised for students to enjoy. Academic advising is another service students can access, in addition to workshops and seminars that help them grow individually.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: The University offers a restricted number of on-campus housing options for students. All the rooms come fully furnished as single rooms with shared washrooms, kitchens, and common areas. Many international students opt for homestay arrangements with a local family who can offer a private room, meals, and a supportive environment to learn more about the English language and local culture. Private apartments, shared accommodations, and rental homes are available nearby, so many students choose to live here and commute to their classes.
